name: Hl7VSEthnicGroup
title: hl7VS-ethnicGroup
description: Concepts further defining a patient's ancestry.  In the US, a current use is to use these codes to report ethnicity in line with US federal standards for Hispanic origin.  Used for HL7 Version 2 messaging in the PID segment.
